conventions.boolean: 1 for true, 0 for false, empty for unknown
conventions.parent_ids: ';'-separated list; empty for an initial individual
conventions.genome_repr: interpretation depends on genome_repr_mode: absent for 'hashed', a base64 string for 'compact' (see archipelago_logging.decode_compact), JSON for 'full'. Composite encodings (real_vector_velocity, real_vector_sigma) are JSON objects in both non-hashed modes.
conventions.quoting: RFC 4180 (csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL); read with Python's csv module or pandas

note: Every other event type for this run is in run.jsonl. Join on run_id, island_id and generation.
